integrity: The proof is reconstructed directly from the 2026 map, its equilibrium nullclines, and its Jacobian. The key determinant identity is algebraic. A bundled standard-library checker independently solves the source's two numerical lower equilibria and verifies the determinant identity and unstable eigenvalue.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves instability for a transverse lower nullcline crossing; the degenerate case with unit eigenvalue requires higher-order analysis.
The saddle refinement requires r times the lower-equilibrium prey coordinate to be at most 2.
The theorem is local and does not classify global basin boundaries or non-equilibrium coexistence attractors.
title: Nullcline slope forces generic instability of the lower cooperative-hunting equilibrium
